verdict.rationale: Versioning and rollback of automations is a fair question for a product-management SaaS, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only the REST API, webhook subscriptions and the MCP server. Nothing shows automation version history, change review, or rollback. Webhook create/delete and API CRUD are developer building blocks, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
